## Introduction 
### Summary
This report presents a simplified example of HIV genomic analysis, demonstrating the application of Quarto for the generation and visualisation of genomic data. The content herein is intended for illustrative purposes only and does not reflect actual clinical or epidemiological findings. All data, analyses, and interpretations are simulated to showcase potential reporting workflows in genomic epidemiology.

### Data
A curated simulation HIV dataset was utilised to generate this report, including both a genomic and notification records. The genomic dataset consisted of 330 previously published [1] HIV sequences downloaded from the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI). Additional genomic metadata and the corresponding notification dataset was generated utilising a custom R script, guided by historical value distributions within the annual NSW HIV Strategy 2021-2025 Annual Data Report 2024 [2].

*** 

## Genomic analysis
### Tools and parameters
Following data linkage, HIV-TRACE (version 0.9.2) [3] was utilised to construct a pairwise distance matrix from HIV sequences aligned to HXB2_prrt reference sequence, with a distance threshold of 0.03. The pairwise distance matrix is then used to generate a network visualisation JSON output which defines nodes, edges and clusters.

<br>

### Molecular cluster network
Interactive molecular cluster network, generated using a force-directed algorithm, that can be coloured by HIV-1 subtype, stage of infection, risk of exposure or acquisition.

```{python}
#| echo: false

# # Read metadata
# with open('./testing_metadata.json', 'r') as input_metadata_file:
#     metadata = json.load(input_metadata_file)

# md = metadata["data"]
md = records_metadata

# Read from HIVTRACE json
with open('../../results/analysis/hiv/hivtrace_output.json', 'r') as inputfile:
    data = json.load(inputfile)

converted = {
	"nodes" : data["trace_results"]["Nodes"]["id"],
  "links": [
      {"source": pair[0], "target": pair[1]} for pair in data["trace_results"]["Edges"]["sequences"]
  ],
  "distances": data["trace_results"]["Edges"]["length"],
  "cluster_sizes": data["trace_results"]["Cluster sizes"]
}

links_data = {"links" : converted["links"]}

node_infection_stage = {entry["external_id"]: entry["metadata"]["stage_of_infection"] for entry in md}
node_risk = {entry["external_id"]: entry["metadata"]["risk_of_exposure"] for entry in md}
node_subtype = {entry["external_id"]: entry["metadata"]["subtype"] for entry in md}
node_acquisition = {entry["external_id"]: entry["metadata"]["acquisition"] for entry in md}

# Color maps
infection_labels = sorted(set(node_infection_stage.values()))
risk_labels = sorted(set(node_risk.values()))
subtype_labels = sorted(set(node_subtype.values()))
acquisition_labels = sorted(set(node_acquisition.values()))

infection_color_map = {label: px.colors.qualitative.Vivid[i % len(infection_labels)] for i, label in enumerate(infection_labels)}
risk_color_map = {label: px.colors.qualitative.Vivid[i % len(risk_labels)] for i, label in enumerate(risk_labels)}
subtype_color_map = {label: px.colors.qualitative.Vivid[i % len(subtype_labels)] for i, label in enumerate(subtype_labels)}
acquisition_color_map = {label: px.colors.qualitative.Vivid[i % len(acquisition_labels)] for i, label in enumerate(acquisition_labels)}

# Create NetworkX graph
G = nx.Graph()
for link in links_data["links"]:
    G.add_edge(link["source"], link["target"])

pos = nx.spring_layout(G, method="energy", seed=0)
# pos = nx.kamada_kawai_layout(G, seed=0)
# pos = nx.spring_layout(G, seed=0)

# Background nodes to still show on isolation mode
node_x = []
node_y = []

for node in G.nodes():
    x, y = pos[node]
    node_x.append(x)
    node_y.append(y)

background_node_trace = go.Scatter(
    x=node_x,
    y=node_y,
    mode='markers',
    hoverinfo='skip',
    marker=dict(size=10, color="#aaa", line_width=0, opacity=0.8),
    showlegend=False
)

# Edge trace
edge_x, edge_y = [], []
for u, v in G.edges():
    x0, y0 = pos[u]
    x1, y1 = pos[v]
    edge_x.extend([x0, x1, None])
    edge_y.extend([y0, y1, None])

edge_trace = go.Scatter(
    x=edge_x,
    y=edge_y,
    line=dict(width=1, color="#888"),
    hoverinfo="none",
    mode="lines",
    showlegend=False
)

# Create node traces for colouring
def create_node_traces(labels, node_attr, color_map, pos, visible):
    traces = []
    for label in labels:
        nodes = [n for n in G.nodes() if node_attr.get(n) == label]
        x_vals = [pos[n][0] for n in nodes]
        y_vals = [pos[n][1] for n in nodes]
        traces.append(go.Scatter(
            x=x_vals,
            y=y_vals,
            mode="markers",
            name=label,
            hoverinfo="text",
            hovertext=nodes,
            marker=dict(size=10, color=color_map[label], line_width=0),
            visible=visible
        ))
    return traces

node_traces_infection = create_node_traces(infection_labels, node_infection_stage, infection_color_map, pos, True)
node_traces_risk = create_node_traces(risk_labels, node_risk, risk_color_map, pos, False)
node_traces_subtype = create_node_traces(subtype_labels, node_subtype, subtype_color_map, pos, False)
node_traces_acquisition = create_node_traces(acquisition_labels, node_acquisition, acquisition_color_map, pos, False)

# Create figure
fig = go.Figure(
    data= [background_node_trace] + [edge_trace] + node_traces_infection + node_traces_risk + node_traces_subtype + node_traces_acquisition
)

# Dropdown visibility masks
vis_edge = [True]
vis_background_nodes = [True]
vis_infection = [True]*len(node_traces_infection) + [False]*len(node_traces_risk) + [False]*len(node_traces_subtype) + [False]*len(node_traces_acquisition)
vis_risk = [False]*len(node_traces_infection) + [True]*len(node_traces_risk) + [False]*len(node_traces_subtype) + [False]*len(node_traces_acquisition)
vis_subtype = [False]*len(node_traces_infection) + [False]*len(node_traces_risk) + [True]*len(node_traces_subtype) + [False]*len(node_traces_acquisition)
vis_acquisition = [False]*len(node_traces_infection) + [False]*len(node_traces_risk) + [False]*len(node_traces_subtype) + [True]*len(node_traces_acquisition)

visibility_options = {
    "Stage of Infection": vis_edge + vis_background_nodes + vis_infection,
    "Risk of Exposure": vis_edge + vis_background_nodes + vis_risk,
    "Subtype": vis_edge + vis_background_nodes + vis_subtype,
    "Acquisition": vis_edge + vis_background_nodes + vis_acquisition
}

# Generate buttons list
buttons = []
for label, vis in visibility_options.items():
    buttons.append(
        dict(
            label=label,
            method="update",
            args=[
                {"visible": vis},
                {"title.text": f"Molecular Cluster Network – {label}"}
            ],
        )
    )

fig.update_layout(
    title="Molecular Cluster Network – Stage of Infection",  # default title
    height=800,
    updatemenus=[
        dict(
            type="dropdown",
            direction="down",
            xanchor="center",
            yanchor="top",
            showactive=True,
            x=0.88,
            y=1.06,
            buttons=buttons,
        )
    ],
    xaxis=dict(showgrid=False, zeroline=False, showticklabels=False, scaleanchor="y", domain=[0, 1]),
    yaxis=dict(showgrid=False, zeroline=False, showticklabels=False),
    margin=dict(b=60, t=70),
    hovermode='closest',
    legend=dict(
        orientation="h",
        yanchor="top",
        y=-0.03,
        xanchor="center",
        x=0.5,
        bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)'
    )
)

fig.show(config={
    "toImageButtonOptions": {
        "format": "svg",  # instead of 'png'
        "filename": "cluster_network_figure",
        "height": 600,
        "width": 800,
        "scale": 1
    }
})

```


**Figure 1. Hypothetical molecular cluster network of individuals infected with HIV-1.**
The edges represent genetic distance between nodes of less than a threshold of 0.03, and the nodes can be dynamically coloured to represent HIV-1 subtype, stage of infection, risk of exposure or acquisition.

```{python}
#| echo: false
dfs = {}
characteristics = ['Subtype', 'Stage of Infection', 'Risk of exposure', 'Acquisition']

# Map display names to actual column names in data
colnames = {
    'Subtype': 'subtype',
    'Stage of Infection': 'stage_of_infection',
    'Risk of exposure': 'risk_of_exposure',
    'Acquisition': 'acquisition'
}

# Step 1: Collect characteristic values AND date_of_collection
def floor_to_6month(dt):
    # Floors datetime to nearest Jan 1 or Jul 1 of the year
    year = dt.year
    if dt.month < 7:
        return pd.Timestamp(year=year, month=1, day=1)
    else:
        return pd.Timestamp(year=year, month=7, day=1)

def collect_date_and_values(data, field_name):
    records = []
    for record in data:
        metadata = record.get("metadata", {})
        value = metadata.get(field_name)
        date_of_collection = metadata.get("date_of_collection")
        date_parsed = pd.to_datetime(date_of_collection, dayfirst=True).floor('D')
        records.append([date_parsed, value])

    return pd.DataFrame(records, columns=['date_of_collection', field_name])

# Create dataframes per characteristic with date_of_collection
for ch in characteristics:
    df = collect_date_and_values(md, colnames[ch])
    dfs[ch] = df

# Create dropdown traces per characteristic
fig = go.Figure()
trace_idx = 0
palette = px.colors.qualitative.Prism

colours = {
    'Subtype': subtype_color_map,
    'Stage of Infection': infection_color_map,
    'Risk of exposure': risk_color_map,
    'Acquisition' : acquisition_color_map
}

label_orders = {
    'Subtype': subtype_labels,
    'Stage of Infection': infection_labels,
    'Risk of exposure': risk_labels,
    'Acquisition' : acquisition_labels
}

for i, ch in enumerate(characteristics):
    df = dfs[ch]
    colname = colnames[ch]
    df['date_binned'] = df['date_of_collection'].apply(floor_to_6month)

    # Group by date and characteristic category and count
    counts = df.groupby(['date_binned', colname]).size().reset_index(name='count')

    # Calculate total per date for proportions
    total_counts = counts.groupby('date_binned')['count'].transform('sum')
    counts['proportion'] = counts['count'] / total_counts

    # Pivot to wide format for stacked bars
    pivot = counts.pivot(index='date_binned', columns=colname, values='proportion').fillna(0)

    # Ensure consistent ordering
    ordered_cols = [c for c in label_orders[ch] if c in pivot.columns]
    pivot = pivot[ordered_cols]

    try:
        pivot.index = pivot.index.to_series().dt.strftime('%b %Y')  # e.g. "Jan 2021", "Jul 2021"
    except Exception:
        pivot.index = pivot.index.astype(str)

    # Create traces for each category within characteristic
    for j, category in enumerate(pivot.columns):
        fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
            x=pivot.index,
            y=pivot[category],
            name=str(category),
            visible=(i == 0),  # only first characteristic visible initially
            legendgroup=ch,
            showlegend=True,
            hovertemplate=f'{ch}: {category}<br>Date collected: %{{x}}<br>Proportion: %{{y:.2%}}<extra></extra>',
            # marker_color=palette[j % len(palette)]
            marker_color=colours[ch][category]
        ))

# Create dropdown buttons to toggle between characteristics
buttons = []
trace_idx = 0
for i, ch in enumerate(characteristics):
    df = dfs[ch]
    colname = colnames[ch]
    categories = df[colname].unique()
    n_categories = len(categories)

    visible = [False] * len(fig.data)
    # Make visible only traces for current characteristic
    for j in range(n_categories):
        visible[trace_idx + j] = True
    trace_idx += n_categories

    buttons.append(dict(
        label=ch,
        method='update',
        args=[{'visible': visible},
              {'title': f'Proportional Distribution of {ch} Over Time',
               'xaxis': {'title': 'Date Collected'},
               'yaxis': {'title': 'Proportion', 'tickformat': '.0%'}}
             ]
    ))

fig.update_layout(
    barmode='stack',
    # title=f'Proportional Distribution of {characteristics[0]} Over Time',
    updatemenus=[dict(
        active=0,
        buttons=buttons,
        direction='down',
        x=0.9,
        y=1.15,
        showactive=True,
        xanchor='center',
        yanchor='top'
    )],
    yaxis=dict(tickformat='.0%'),
    xaxis=dict(type='category', tickangle=0),
    margin=dict(b=70, t=90),
    legend=dict(
        orientation="h",
        traceorder="normal",
        yanchor="top",
        y=-0.05,
        xanchor="center",
        x=0.5,
        bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)',
        itemclick=False,
        itemdoubleclick=False
    )
)

fig.show(config={
    "toImageButtonOptions": {
        "format": "svg",  # instead of 'png'
        "filename": "characteristic_dist",
        "height": 600,
        "width": 800,
        "scale": 1
    }
})
```
**Figure 5. Hypothetical distribution of HIV-1 subtype, stage of infection, risk of exposure and acquisition across for all edges within the network, distributed over 6 month periods.** 
Each bar represents the number of cases observed for each category.
